statement: Controller-specific authority was restricted to the x anti-sway channel, while shared y/z control was identical across methods and the formal metric evaluated the full 3D cutter-tip task.
consequence: Advanced methods could not independently improve the shared y/z task channels; equal acquisition on many y/z targets is therefore compatible with the frozen interface contract.
interpretation_boundary: This limitation does not invalidate the preregistered V2 result and does not justify relaxing the V2 win gate.
